title: Evaluation normalization and signed coherence of the reindexed Hom complex
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and $B_{W,n}=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)_W$, $R_W=\lim_n B_{W,n}$ for a scheme $W$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $g:X\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ be a scheme isomorphism, with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Put $F=g^{-1}$, with the coefficient identifications induced by all quotient projections. Use the coefficient-stage derived operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].

For $T_W=B_{W,n}$ or $R_W$ use ordinary ambient derived tensor and internal Hom, their K-flat representative model [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], and the product-Hom comparison $c^0$ of [lem-pod-reindexing-hom-resolution-model]. Let $\mu^0:F(U\otimes^L V)\xrightarrow{\sim}FU\otimes^L FV$ be the total-tensor comparison. Then $c^0$ is the unique map with
$$\operatorname{ev}_{FM,FN}(1\otimes c^0_{g;M,N})\mu^0_{M,H(M,N)}=F(\operatorname{ev}_{M,N}).$$
On flat-term K-flat representatives evaluation is the ordinary Hom-complex evaluation followed by inverse localized augmentation of the K-injective target. With factors $f\otimes x$ its local formula is $f(x)$; reversing to $x\otimes f$ uses the same Koszul symmetry on each side. The ordinary derived tensor-Hom transposition is normalized by this formula. For $b:M\otimes^L L\to N$ its transported transpose is $c^0_{g;M,N}F(b^\sharp)$, namely the transpose of $F(b)(\mu^0_{M,L})^{-1}$. These equalities are natural contravariantly in $M$ and covariantly in $N$.

For all integers $a,b$, the square of $c^0$ with the canonical signed comparison $H(M[a],N[b])\cong H(M,N)[\,b-a\,]$ commutes, using the differential $d_{K[a]}=(-1)^a d_K$ and the degreewise identity shift comparison for $F$. This holds already for Hom complexes, with their standard reindexing and integer signs. For $h:Z\xrightarrow{\sim}X$, under the canonical monoidal pullback compositor one has
$$c^0_{gh;M,N}=c^0_{h;FM,FN}\,F_h(c^0_{g;M,N}).$$
The identity map gives the identity comparison. The tensor compositor is the canonical one of [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons]; the equations concern this specified comparison, not an independently chosen equivalence.

proof.text: Obtain a Comparison and its evaluation equation from evaluated_comparison_exists. The presentation definitions are unchanged and re-exported from the data module.

The inverse closed transpose sends d to tensor(d,1) followed by evaluation. Cancel the invertible tensor comparison and use injectivity of this inverse equivalence to prove uniqueness among all arrows. For transpose transport, apply inverse transposition to both arrows, use tensor-comparison naturality and the evaluation equation, and cancel the tensor isomorphism. Both-variance naturality is already the naturality of the specified derived Hom comparison. These arguments build all EvaluationLaws fields.
Apply signed_shift_laws to the constructed comparison and to every other normalized comparison. This gives both signed-shift clauses of comparison_exists.

For the recorded Comparison presentation, the chain comparison is unique by its product projection formula, and the tensor-chain comparison is unique on the sheafified pure generators of every total summand. The derived-model formula then fixes the derived Hom comparison on every localized pair (QP,QI) with I K-injective. Replace an arbitrary second complex by its functorial K-injective resolution and use naturality and cancellation of the localized augmentation. Localization extensionality proves equality of the two natural comparisons. Similarly the tensor-model formula fixes the tensor comparison on K-flat pairs; take independent K-flat resolutions in both variables and apply localization extensionality. Therefore EvaluationLaws for the comparison supplied by comparison_exists transport to every normalized Comparison, proving evaluation_laws without a further existence assertion. Total-tensor extensionality is the proved coefficient_total_ext helper of the coefficient tensor-curry normalization module; it uses sheafification and the total-summand universal property.

The flat-term representative evaluation formula is proved from the one-sided chain transpose for the identity of the actual Hom complex. Postcompose by the inverse localized target augmentation and use counit naturality.

For composition take the site/tensor compositor from tensor_compositor_exists. The successive Hom comparison satisfies the composite evaluation equation by naturality of the second tensor comparison and the two evaluation equations. Uncurry both proposed Hom maps. Naturality of evaluation in the source and target, the tensor compositor square, and naturality of the compositor identify these uncurries. Cancel the invertible source tensor map and apply injectivity of the closed transpose. This proves the Hom equation for that very compositor, without an additional Hom-coherence assumption.

For identity take the site/tensor identification from tensor_identity_exists. Apply the same evaluation transport calculation with the identity functor, identity tensor comparison and identity Hom comparison. Uncurrying and the tensor identity square show that the specified comparison becomes the identity.

Retain the proved symmetry argument: use the tensorChain pure-generator formula and the canonical signed chain swap, cancel tensorChain inverses and apply total-tensor generator extensionality. Localize on K-flat pairs using tensor_model and naturality of podReindexingDerivedFactors. Extend to arbitrary pairs using independent K-flat resolutions and naturality of both braidings.
